subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Kumusta RECIPIENT_NAME,
Sinusundan ko lang ang naunang email ko tungkol sa pagpapataas ng completed ride para sa app ninyo. Isang puntos ang ulitin ko: nag-o-optimize kami patungo sa unang natapos na biyahe na may bayad, na-validate gamit ang S2S postback mula sa MMP na may trip ID at pamasahe, matapos pumasa sa fraud screening laban sa incentivized install at device farm. Sa ganitong setup, malinis lang ang completed-ride event na binabayaran ninyo sa tinatayang eCPA na 4 na dolyar. Kung makakatulong, ipapadala ko ang completed-ride view ayon sa lungsod. Mag-uusap kaya tayo nang maikli?
angle: warm bump, restate completed-ride validation proof
illustrative_flags: eCPA na 4 na dolyar sa completed-ride event (eCPA of $4 on the completed-ride event) - MobUpps illustrative placeholder, not an established result
register_notes: Stage 1 tl ride_hailing UA: native Tagalog, neutral 'Kumusta' greeting with RECIPIENT_NAME slot preserved; references prior email in first sentence. Restates ONE proof point = optimize to first completed ride validated via S2S MMP postback (trip ID + fare) with fraud screening. One MobUpps figure (eCPA $4) is illustrative and flagged. Soft collaborative CTA; exactly one question mark. No sign-off; no em-dash; no curly quotes; no hedge before number; no 'X, not Y' comma-negation.
